mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `file` WHERE md5 = #{md5} AND is_dir = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 AND storage_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE `file` SET ref_count = ref_count + 1 WHERE storage_key = #{storageKey}
UPDATE `file` SET ref_count = ref_count - #{delta} WHERE storage_key = #{storageKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `file` (user_id, parent_id, name, is_dir, size, md5, storage_key, ref_count, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{isDir}, #{size}, #{md5}, #{storageKey}, #{refCount}, #{isDeleted})
